resources.string: TakeBack Accessibility Service detects when restricted applications or distracting websites are opened and displays your custom focus shield.
Shows active distraction protection and scheduled focus state.
Enables TakeBack to deter unauthorized changes, settings tampering, and casual uninstallation while Strict Mode is active.
Warning: Deactivating TakeBack Device Administrator compromises your active Strict Mode protections, allowing profiles and restrictions to be bypassed. Are you sure you want to proceed?
